WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  INNER JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat, avg_ambictemp, avg_imgcount,
       avg_imgcount - (SELECT AVG(avg_imgcount) FROM status_averages) AS imgcount_avg_minus_status_mean
FROM status_averages;
